question: What adverse consequences follow if unguent sticks to the hand or foot?
premises: Unguent sticking to the hand leads to poverty
Unguent sticking to the foot leads to loss of wealth
Both outcomes are stated as consequences
inference: If unguent sticks to the hand one becomes poor, and if to the foot one suffers loss of wealth.
plain_english: If it sticks to the hand, one becomes poor; if it sticks to the foot, there is loss of wealth.
